{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0,
    parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1,
    parameter W = 2**LEVELS
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] winner;
    localparam [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] EMPTY_INDEX = LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY ? W-1 : 0;
    genvar i, b, j;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i+1) begin : g_winner
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : g_low
                if (i == 0) begin : g_edge
                    assign winner[i] = input_unencoded[i];
                end else begin : g_inner
                    assign winner[i] = input_unencoded[i] & ~(|input_unencoded[i-1:0]);
                end
            end else begin : g_high
                if (i == WIDTH-1) begin : g_edge
                    assign winner[i] = input_unencoded[i];
                end else begin : g_inner
                    assign winner[i] = input_unencoded[i] & ~(|input_unencoded[WIDTH-1:i+1]);
                end
            end
        end
        for (b = 0; b < $bits(output_encoded); b = b+1) begin : g_encode
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] terms;
            for (j = 0; j < WIDTH; j = j+1) begin : g_term
                if ((j >> b) & 1) begin : g_one
                    assign terms[j] = winner[j];
                end else begin : g_zero
                    assign terms[j] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
            assign output_encoded[b] = (|terms) | (~output_valid & EMPTY_INDEX[b]);
        end
    endgenerate
    assign output_valid = |input_unencoded;
    assign output_unencoded = winner | (output_valid ? {WIDTH{1'b0}} : ({{WIDTH{1'b0}}} | (1 << EMPTY_INDEX)));
endmodule

module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] request,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] grant,
    output wire grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);
    reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg, grant_next;
    reg grant_valid_reg, grant_valid_next;
    reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg, grant_encoded_next;
    reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg, mask_next;

    assign grant = grant_reg;
    assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
    assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

    wire request_valid;
    wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] request_index;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] request_mask;
    wire masked_request_valid;
    wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] masked_request_index;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_mask;

    priority_encoder #(
        .WIDTH(PORTS), .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
    ) priority_encoder_inst (
        .input_unencoded(request),
        .output_valid(request_valid),
        .output_encoded(request_index),
        .output_unencoded(request_mask)
    );
    priority_encoder #(
        .WIDTH(PORTS), .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
    ) priority_encoder_masked (
        .input_unencoded(request & mask_reg),
        .output_valid(masked_request_valid),
        .output_encoded(masked_request_index),
        .output_unencoded(masked_request_mask)
    );

    wire [PORTS-1:0] request_next_mask;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_next_mask;
    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < PORTS; k = k+1) begin : g_next_mask
            if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : g_low
                if (k == 0) begin : g_edge
                    assign request_next_mask[k] = 1'b0;
                    assign masked_next_mask[k] = 1'b0;
                end else begin : g_inner
                    assign request_next_mask[k] = |request_mask[k-1:0];
                    assign masked_next_mask[k] = |masked_request_mask[k-1:0];
                end
            end else begin : g_high
                if (k == PORTS-1) begin : g_edge
                    assign request_next_mask[k] = 1'b0;
                    assign masked_next_mask[k] = 1'b0;
                end else begin : g_inner
                    assign request_next_mask[k] = |request_mask[PORTS-1:k+1];
                    assign masked_next_mask[k] = |masked_request_mask[PORTS-1:k+1];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    always @* begin
        grant_next = 0;
        grant_valid_next = 0;
        grant_encoded_next = 0;
        mask_next = mask_reg;
        if (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (|(grant_reg & request))) begin
            grant_next = grant_reg;
            grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
            grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
        end else if (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid_reg && !(|(grant_reg & acknowledge))) begin
            grant_next = grant_reg;
            grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
            grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
        end else if (request_valid) begin
            grant_valid_next = 1'b1;
            if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN) begin
                if (masked_request_valid) begin
                    grant_next = masked_request_mask;
                    grant_encoded_next = masked_request_index;
                    mask_next = masked_next_mask;
                end else begin
                    grant_next = request_mask;
                    grant_encoded_next = request_index;
                    mask_next = request_next_mask;
                end
            end else begin
                grant_next = request_mask;
                grant_encoded_next = request_index;
            end
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            grant_reg <= 0;
            grant_valid_reg <= 0;
            grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
            mask_reg <= 0;
        end else begin
            grant_reg <= grant_next;
            grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
            grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
            mask_reg <= mask_next;
        end
    end
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original round-robin feedback path passes through a priority-encoder mux tree, binary-to-one-hot decoding, or variable-shift mask generation, followed by blocking and reset selection. At 32 ports, the encoded-index-to-mask shift is an avoidable serial dependency.",
  "rewrite": "Compute priority winners directly using directional prefix reductions. Encode winners with parallel OR reductions instead of cascaded encoded-data muxes. Generate each round-robin mask bit by reducing the appropriate strict range of the one-hot winner, eliminating the binary-index variable shifts. Preserve the original named registers, encoder instances, next-state priority, and synchronous reset.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to improve setup WNS by removing encode-then-decode and encode-then-shift dependencies. The magnitude depends on SKY130HD mapping, buffering, and placement; no measured timing gain or passing STA result is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses parallel reduction logic, potentially increasing intermediate wiring and fanout while eliminating shift and decode logic. Register count and registered latency are unchanged. Area-cap compliance and electrical checks require synthesis and physical evaluation; they have not been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves blocking-on-acknowledge, blocking-on-request, both priority directions, fixed-priority mode, wraparound selection, idle grant clearing, mask retention, and repeated synchronous reset. No initialization or startup assumptions are introduced. Register names and encodings remain unchanged. Invalid encoder outputs retain the original default index and corresponding truncated one-hot result. Equivalence and implementation checks must still be run under the stated reset and arbitrary-initial-state contract."
}
